claim: Structured, attributed handoffs are a promising coordination design; this corpus does not measure ResearchRelay productivity.

source_notes.access: publisher full-text HTML and bibliographic record
source_notes.findings: Combining people and AI did not consistently beat the stronger component; task type and relative component ability mattered.[^vaccaro-2024-human-ai]
source_notes.implication: Measure coordination effort and research quality against human-only and agent-only baselines; do not assume collaboration creates synergy.
source_notes.limitations: The included studies end in June 2023 and vary in design; this is not a direct test of current agentic research teams.
source_notes.methods: Preregistered meta-analysis: 106 experiments and 370 effect sizes, with human-only, AI-only, and combined conditions.[^vaccaro-2024-human-ai]
source_notes.title: When combinations of humans and AI are useful: A systematic review and meta-analysis

source_notes.access: author-hosted camera-ready PDF, abstract and evaluation description
source_notes.findings: The authors organize practical interaction guidance around introducing AI, routine use, failures, and longer-term adaptation.[^amershi-2019-guidelines]
source_notes.implication: Expose capabilities, uncertainty, recent changes, correction paths, and recoverable failures; ask participants whether handoffs are understandable.
source_notes.limitations: Evaluates guideline relevance, rather than causal productivity gains or asynchronous scientific agents.
source_notes.methods: Iterative synthesis and evaluation, including 49 design practitioners assessing 20 AI-enabled products.[^amershi-2019-guidelines]
source_notes.title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
source_notes.venue: CHI '19: Proceedings of the 2019 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems

source_notes.access: arXiv abstract and submission metadata; peer-reviewed publication not established in this search
source_notes.findings: A research-assistant pipeline covers literature, experimentation, and reporting, with human feedback reported to improve the resulting work.[^schmidgall-2025-agent-laboratory]
source_notes.implication: Keep researchers involved at methodological checkpoints and collect observed coordination, review, rework, and comprehension measures.
source_notes.limitations: Author-reported quality and cost findings depend on tasks, baselines, models, and evaluation choices; they are not ResearchRelay productivity measurements.
source_notes.methods: Model comparisons, generated code/report outputs, and researcher feedback/evaluation across staged research workflows.[^schmidgall-2025-agent-laboratory]
source_notes.title: Agent Laboratory: Using LLM Agents as Research Assistants

source_notes.access: publisher abstract, citation metadata and BibTeX
source_notes.findings: Perspective-driven questioning and source-grounded outlining improved evaluated article organization and breadth over an outline-based retrieval baseline.[^shao-2024-storm]
source_notes.implication: Separate source collection from synthesis, keep per-claim citations, and ask a second participant to inspect coverage and unsupported associations.
source_notes.limitations: The task is encyclopedic writing; editor feedback identifies transferred source bias and associations between unrelated facts.
source_notes.methods: STORM combines retrieval, simulated expert conversations, FreshWiki outline assessments, and feedback from experienced Wikipedia editors.[^shao-2024-storm]
source_notes.title: Assisting in Writing Wikipedia-like Articles From Scratch with Large Language Models

source_notes.access: publisher abstract, citation metadata and BibTeX
source_notes.findings: Relevant information can be used less reliably when placed in the middle of long contexts, even in long-context-capable models.[^liu-2024-lost-middle]
source_notes.implication: Offer an index and focused source notes, pin the context actually consumed, and test whether important unresolved questions survive handoffs.
source_notes.limitations: The tested models and synthetic/task settings do not determine present-day model performance or an optimal project-memory policy.
source_notes.methods: Position-controlled multi-document question answering and key-value retrieval evaluations.[^liu-2024-lost-middle]
source_notes.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
source_notes.venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics 12, 157–173

source_notes.access: normative specification abstract, status, and conceptual overview
source_notes.findings: The model distinguishes produced entities, activities, responsible agents, and derivation relationships.[^w3c-2013-prov]
source_notes.implication: Record user and agent responsibility, source versions, input/output derivations, and execution evidence without equating provenance with validity.
source_notes.limitations: Provenance descriptions support inspection but do not prove that an activity occurred correctly or that an output is scientifically sound.
source_notes.methods: A domain-independent provenance specification with extensible structures, rather than an empirical agent-productivity study.[^w3c-2013-prov]
source_notes.title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model

source_notes.access: Search-indexed conference PDF abstract and author metadata; acceptance cross-checked against COLM accepted-paper list. Direct OpenReview retrieval encountered browser verification.
source_notes.findings: Configurable agents combine models, people, and tools through programmable conversation patterns across varied applications.[^wu-2024-autogen]
source_notes.implication: Separate provider adapters from coordination policy; persist explicit handoff state instead of treating chat history as the execution ledger.
source_notes.limitations: Framework case studies do not establish that multi-agent conversation always outperforms simpler execution or reduces scientific coordination costs.
source_notes.methods: Framework implementation and application-specific evaluations using multiple agent interaction arrangements.[^wu-2024-autogen]
source_notes.title: AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversations

source_notes.access: official proceedings abstract and bibliographic record
source_notes.findings: Role-specific standard operating procedures structure intermediate work and verification, with improvements reported on software-engineering benchmarks.[^hong-2024-metagpt]
source_notes.implication: Define task outputs and acceptance criteria before execution; make scientific questions explicit rather than embedding decisions in role prompts.
source_notes.limitations: Evidence concerns software tasks and evaluated model configurations, not open-ended scientific validity or autonomous assignment of research priorities.
source_notes.methods: Multi-agent software workflow using role prompts, ordered subtasks, and checks on intermediate outputs.[^hong-2024-metagpt]
source_notes.title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework

source_notes.access: arXiv abstract and Microsoft technical-report metadata; no peer-reviewed venue established
source_notes.findings: An orchestrator delegates to specialized agents, monitors progress, and replans after problems across several computer-use benchmarks.[^fourney-2024-magentic-one]
source_notes.implication: Persist plan/progress separately, bound retries, retain blockers, and isolate repeated executions before attributing gains to coordination.
source_notes.limitations: General computer-use benchmarks differ from long-running scientific teamwork; benchmark results do not validate scientific conclusions or multi-user governance.
source_notes.methods: GAIA, AssistantBench, and WebArena evaluation with ablations and an isolation/repetition-oriented evaluation harness.[^fourney-2024-magentic-one]
source_notes.title: Magentic-One: A Generalist Multi-Agent System for Solving Complex Tasks

source_notes.access: official proceedings abstract and bibliographic record
source_notes.findings: Task-specific agent-computer interfaces affect repository navigation, code editing, test execution, and benchmark issue resolution.[^yang-2024-swe-agent]
source_notes.implication: Give agents precise task/context/result interfaces and keep computational checks separate from peer review and human scientific judgment.
source_notes.limitations: Passing software tests on benchmark tasks is distinct from correct research methods, valid evidence, or effective collaboration between people.
source_notes.methods: An interactive coding agent evaluated on SWE-bench and HumanEvalFix, with analysis of interface design choices.[^yang-2024-swe-agent]
source_notes.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
source_notes.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37 (NeurIPS 2024), Main Conference Track

source_notes.access: official command documentation and worktree semantics
source_notes.findings: Linked working trees provide separate working directories and per-worktree state while sharing a repository object store.[^git-2026-worktree]
source_notes.implication: Use isolated workspaces for execution and normal non-force pushes, while detecting stale touched files and presenting reconciliation choices.
source_notes.limitations: Worktrees are not security sandboxes and do not resolve competing edits or enforce a team review policy by themselves.
source_notes.methods: Operational documentation for branching, worktree lifecycle, repair, and repository metadata.[^git-2026-worktree]
source_notes.title: git-worktree: Manage multiple working trees

source_notes.access: canonical SPEC.md and repository README; selected reference, intended user adoption unconfirmed
source_notes.findings: The specification organizes linked Markdown concepts with YAML metadata, source-keyed attribution, authorship/trust signals, and lifecycle information.[^google-2026-okf]
source_notes.implication: Adopt its conventions explicitly as a selected reference, mark the ResearchRelay extension profile provisional, and retain readable sources and links.
source_notes.limitations: Format structure does not authenticate an actor or verify claims. The repository did not previously identify this as its intended specification.
source_notes.methods: A portable format specification with reserved directory indexes and update logs; it does not prescribe execution or a provider.[^google-2026-okf]
source_notes.title: Open Knowledge Format (OKF), Version 0.2

limitations: Focused seed search, not a systematic or exhaustive review.
Most summaries rely on abstracts and metadata; full-text methodological audit is follow-up work.
Preprints, standards, and software manuals are not interchangeable empirical evidence.
Scripted local execution does not establish human coordination savings or scientific validity.
